instruction: In `ds/lru.py`, `get()` returns the right value but does not mark the key as most-recently-used. As a result a subsequent `put()` may evict a key that was just read, dropping a recently-accessed entry from the cache.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds/lru.py b/ds/lru.py
--- a/ds/lru.py
+++ b/ds/lru.py
@@ -20,8 +20,10 @@
         if key not in self._cache:
             self.misses.increment()
             return -1
+        value = self._cache.pop(key)
+        self._cache[key] = value
         self.hits.increment()
-        return self._cache[key]
+        return value
 
     def put(self, key, value):
         if key in self._cache:
